title: Remove CLEAN27 from Service Management
summary: Removes code that had been kept behind the CLEAN27 symbol in Service Management across W1 and many localization layers. This deletes obsolete ES and IT pages and codeunits for updating posted service invoices and shipments and strips the related code from service tables, pages, page extensions, reports and codeunits.
key_points: Removed CLEAN27-guarded code from service documents, history pages, tables and reports
Deleted ES and IT pages for updating posted service invoices and shipments
Deleted the ES and IT codeunits for editing service invoice and shipment headers
Cleaned NA service page extensions and event subscribers
Touches W1, APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, GB, IT, NA and NO layers
